jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Management Specialist
jobs.description:
Senior Technical Product Management Specialist

Company:
The Boeing Company

The Boeing Company is currently seeking a Senior Technical Product Management Specialist to join the team in Seattle, WA; Dallas, TX; North Charleston, SC; Berkeley, MO; Hazelwood, MO; or Mesa, AZ.

We are seeking a highly experienced and visionary Data & Analytics Product Specialist to define, evolve, and deliver innovative data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) products that power business growth. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical expertise in Data and AI technologies with a strong product mindset - translating business needs into clear product strategies, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.

In this role, you will own the lifecycle of our data and analytics offerings - from discovery and requirements definition to design, delivery, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders to shape solutions that unlock insights, accelerate decision-making, and drive enterprise-wide value. Acting as the voice of the product, you will champion adoption, ensure alignment with the company’s strategic priorities, and continuously explore new opportunities to extend our cloud, data, and AI capabilities.

Join us in shaping the next generation of our cloud, data, and AI strategy - where your vision will directly influence how the business thinks, operates, and grows.

Position Responsibilities:

- Lead and drive the vision, roadmap and priorities for Enterprise data and analytics products aligned with business goals

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, design, marketing, and sales to deliver successful product releases

- Lead end-to-end product lifecycle management from concept through launch and iteration

- Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, and ensure timely delivery of features

- Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure program delivery milestones, earned value management, risks, dependencies etc.

- Lead product investment decisions, including budget planning, resource allocation, and vendor partnerships to maximize value and accelerate delivery

- Drive alignment and engagement through regular product reviews, executive showcases with multiple Vice Presidents (VPs) and senior leaders around the product vision, strategy, and roadmap

- Ensure delivery of high quality, scalable data solutions – including data platforms, governed data products, AI and Business Intelligence (BI) solutions

- Lead adoption of data platforms, tools and analytics practices through effective change management

- Identify and proactively manage risks related to data availability, quality, architecture or other areas as needed

- Identify opportunities for innovation and new product initiatives based on market trends and customer needs

- Foster knowledge sharing across teams (Establish Centers of excellence, Communities of practice etc.)

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):

- 5+ years of experience with technical product management

- 3+ years of experience developing & maintaining relationships & partnerships with senior executives and stakeholders

- 3+ years of experience with cloud-platform technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP)

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):

- 10 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of education and experience

- Current PMP or PgMP certifications

- Current Agile/Scrum (e.g., CSM, SAFe) certifications

- Current cloud certification (e.g., AWZ, Azure, GCP, etc.)

- Experience working with all levels from individual contributor to senior leadership

- Experience leading multi-year and multi-million-dollar programs

- Experience with data ecosystems

Conflict Of Interest:
Successful Candidates for this job must satisfy the Company’s Conflict Of Interest (COI) assessment process.

Drug Free Workplace:
Boeing is a Drug Free Workplace where post offer applicants and employees are subject to testing for marijuana, cocaine, opioids, amphetamines, PCP, and alcohol when criteria is met as outlined in our policies .

Pay & Benefits:
At Boeing, we strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent. Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities.

The Boeing Company also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work.

The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

Summary pay range for level 4: $129,200 - $187,450
Summary pay range for level 5: $157,250 - $227,700

Not Applicable

Not Applicable

This position must meet U.S. export control compliance requirements. To meet U.S. export control compliance requirements, a “U.S. Person” as defined by 22 C.F.R. §120.62 is required. “U.S. Person” includes U.S. Citizen, U.S. National, lawful permanent resident, refugee, or asylee.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager – Aviation Maintenance Data
jobs.description:
Technical Product Manager – Aviation Maintenance Data

Company:
Boeing Vancouver

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. From the seabed to outer space, you can contribute to work that matters with a company where diversity, equity and inclusion are shared values. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Boeing Vancouver is seeking a Technical Product Manager reporting to the Senior Manager of the Schedule Reliability Portfolio working out of the Richmond, British Columbia office.

As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in developing a data-driven analytics platform that is a foundation to a suite of advanced products in the areas of airplane maintenance. You’ll work in a multidisciplinary team of domain SMEs, product managers, data scientists and developers. You have a strong desire to build robust and efficient systems. You’re energized by working with multiple stakeholders using their inputs as a basis for the platform roadmap.

You have a keen interest in data analytics, and building products to unlock the value in airplane data. You’re an outstanding communicator who will be the voice of the Technical Product Team both internally and externally, and an excellent team player and positive influencer who works hard to build rapport with customers, teammates and stakeholders.

The Technical Product Manager will drive platform strategy and be responsible for building out core capabilities through analysis and understanding of the products we develop, new technologies and customer business issues.. You’ll lead the Core platform roadmap, prioritizing multiple team’s requirements and dependencies collaborating with product development to build out the core common features across products, monitoring, CI/CD pipeline, Internal Tools and the data processing pipeline. The ideal candidate will apply principles of product management to infrastructure and platforms, with the end customers being product managers and the software development team, brining rigour, velocity and transparency to every layer of the stack.

Boeing Vancouver houses a small but mighty product team, bringing new products to market that enable customers to perform advanced analytics on full-flight airplane sensor data. We’re combining data science expertise and a sharp focus on business impact, with empathy for our customers’ day-to-day struggles, to define a new way of working with airplane data. Together, we deliver the power of understanding to change the world above and on the ground.

The platform is built on an Azure-hosted Databricks Lakehouse, unifying federated domain data under a governed Unity Catalog. The Digital Services team's products are first-class consumers of this platform. The TPM will maintain a clear line of sight between the product portfolio and the shared Data Platform roadmap, ensuring platform capabilities are sequenced to unlock the highest-value product outcomes.

Position Responsibilities:

- Develop and maintain Core Team roadmap; develop and document platform features as input to the development process.
- Manage internal platform stakeholders and achieve the required consensus and approvals to drive platform development forward.
- Communicate with product teams to understand needs and pain points, and gather data pipeline and core capabilities feedback.
- Lead Proof-of-Concept studies to evaluate next generation product capabilities and own a PoC evaluation framework with clear graduation criteria for promoting validated experiments into product grade platform features.
- Own and maintain a platform prioritization governance model; define the forum membership, intake criteria, and dependency-tracking process used to sequence work across multiple consuming product teams.
- Define and execute a CI/CD and platform observability strategy including pipeline health monitoring, deployment automation, and internal tooling so that platform reliability is measurable and continuously improving.
- Establish a PoC evaluation framework with clear graduation criteria for promoting experimental capabilities (e.g. from the Hackathon/Sandbox domain) into production-grade platform features.
- Define the team and customer onboarding pathway for the Data Platform including self-service catalogue access, tiered support tiers, and training materials so consuming teams reach first value quickly.
- Work directly with the software development team to define and implement new capabilities.
- Own the requirements process end-to-end PRDs, acceptance criteria, backlog structure, and SDLC stage gates  leveraging AI-assisted tooling to accelerate quality and consistency across platform and product teams.
- Support the sales and marketing teams in communicating and demonstrating capabilities to customers as part of sales engagements and at conferences.
- Champion a culture of quality, learning, trust, and collaboration.

This position is hybrid. This means that the selected candidate will be required to perform some work onsite at Richmond location. This is at the hiring team’s discretion and could potentially change in the future.

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):

- 7+ years of experience in software product management or product ownership.
- Experience collaborating across teams and developing platforms or frameworks.
- Experience owning a platform or infrastructure roadmap in a multi-team environment, including managing dependencies and establishing governance for stakeholder prioritization.
- Familiarity with CI/CD tools and DevOps practices, with the ability to define requirements and success criteria for platform reliability and deployment pipelines.
- Experience defining or operating a data catalog or data-product discovery capability, such as Unity Catalog, DataHub, Alation, or an equivalent platform.
- Experience with Databricks.
- Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services.
- Legally authorized to work in Canada.
- Must meet applicable requirements for safeguarding controlled goods.
- Must be eligible to access U.S. export-controlled data.

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):

- 8+ years of experience in software product management or product ownership.
- Knowledge of the aviation or aerospace industry.
- Educational or professional background in a STEM field.
- Experience applying data science to real-world problems.
- Experience working in an Agile project-management framework, such as SAFe, Scrum, or Kanban.
- Experience with Python.
- Understanding of aviation maintenance data flows, including MRO work orders, Aircraft Maintenance Manual procedures, aircraft health monitoring, and engineering configuration data from systems such as Trax, AMOS, SAP, or MXI.
- Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog governance, Delta Sharing, or federated data mesh architectures.
- Postsecondary education in a related field.
- Experience taking a data platform to market externally, including developing an API catalog or developer portal, delivering a consumption-based SaaS offering, or designing customer onboarding and support models.
- Experience using AI-assisted product workflows—such as drafting PRDs, synthesizing requirements, refining backlogs, and summarizing meetings—to improve quality and efficiency while retaining human judgment and domain expertise.

Conflict of Interest:

Successful candidates for this job must satisfy the Company's Conflict of Interest (COI) assessment process.

Relocation:

Relocation assistance is not a negotiable benefit for this position. Candidates must live in the immediate area or relocate at their own expense.

Additional Information:

This requisition is for a locally hired position in Canada. The employer is Boeing Canada.  Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Canada. Benefits and pay are determined by Canada and are not on Boeing US-based payroll. This is not an expatriate assignment.

jobs.title: Product Owner - Manufacturing Harness - Millennium Space Systems
jobs.description:
Product Owner - Manufacturing Harness - Millennium Space Systems

Company:
Millennium Space Systems

Millennium Space Systems, a part of Boeing Defense, Space and Security (BDS), is a fast, agile small satellite company focused on national security space. Our missions have direct impact to global security, like missile warning and Earth observation.

Our team is curious, bold and innovative. We take risks, innovate and explore new techniques and technologies. We influence change because we challenge the status quo. And when we watch our satellites launch, we know each one of us made it happen.

As a Product Owner - Manufacturing Harness, you will collaboratively manage the schedule, budget, and technical oversight of subsystem deliverables for assigned control accounts to one or many programs. You will be empowered to and responsible for driving the team execution for delivering quality hardware against program delivery dates, optimizing production capacity and improving designs and manufacturability to meet required manufacturing rates. The position will require working with company and program management, multiple engineering teams, production, ATLO (Assembly, Test, and Launch Operations), and our Customers to deliver qualified subsystem components on time and on budget.

Our team is currently hiring for level 4.

Position Responsibilities:
- Coordinate with Program Management Offices (including MPMs) to understand and prioritize deliverable hardware

- Drive team execution (day to day) and execution of upcoming milestones, thru facilitation of all functions in the flow from demand entry, procurement through delivery

- Manage technical project scope, planning, proposals, cost estimates, schedules, cost performance, Estimates at Completion (EAC), Risk assessment throughout the program lifecycle

- Update program LRE (Latest Revised Estimate) planners, schedules, and provide Earned Value Management inputs, including variance analysis and corrective action planning

- Develop and maintain a historical data set for cost and schedule projections providing inputs to program delivery Baselines

- Work closely with Production Scheduling function to ensure hardware build schedules in shared production areas meet program needs

- Develop a product roadmap that aligns with the Companies long range business plans and work with Engineering to identify, authorize and manage technical changes to deliverable unit designs to meet those plans

- Represent control account(s) as a recognized technical authority and performance manager

- Track and update key subsystem TPMs (Technical Performance Metrics)

- Identify issues and risks early, proactively resolve issues that impede program progress, obtain assistance when needed to allow design staff to concentrate on their work products

- Track/Manage subsystem DRs (Discrepancy Reports) and work with respective engineering teams to close out any open DRs in a timely fashion to keep MFG floor work moving

- Status key subsystem deliverables to program management, customers, and other stakeholders

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):
- Education/experience typically acquired through advanced technical education from an accredited course of study in engineering, engineering technology (includes manufacturing engineering technology), computer science, engineering data science, mathematics, physics or chemistry (e.g. Bachelor) and typically 9 or more years' related work experience or an equivalent combination of technical education and experience or non-US equivalent qualifications. In the USA, ABET accreditation is the preferred, although not required, accreditation standard

- Experience with Jira, MS Excel, Word, Project, and PowerPoint

- Experience leading engineering and/or manufacturing teams and personnel

- Experience with Wire Harness Product Lifecycle

- This position requires the ability to obtain a U.S. Security Clearance for which the U.S. Government requires U.S. Citizenship. A U.S. Security Clearance Post-Start is required

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience):
- Project Leadership experience

- Excellent verbal and written communication skill

- Experience with Harness Design

- Experience with PCB Design

- Experience using tools and metrics in managing activities

- Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace, Computer, Electrical, Manufacturing or Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science, or Electronic Design

- Understanding of execution methodologies (waterfall, agile, etc) and the ability to tailor them based on program needs

- Demonstrate the ability to balance the needs of multiple programs and stakeholders in a resource and schedule constrained environment

- Ability to determine and proactively act on program execution trends

- Knowledge of satellite systems and components

- Experience with Confluence

- Active TS/SCI Clearance
